name: NSW Fee-Free TAFE and Fee Free training
provider: NSW Government (Skills NSW) and TAFE NSW
summary: Tuition-free priority courses at TAFE NSW and other Smart and Skilled providers for eligible NSW residents.
key: Skills NSW provides fully subsidised training to gain skills in Australia's growing industries.
who: 15 years or over and no longer at school.
Australian citizen, permanent resident, humanitarian visa holder or NZ citizen.
how: Contact a training provider such as TAFE NSW to check a fee-free place is available.
catches: Places are limited and not guaranteed.
TAFE NSW: one Fee-free course per semester.
Semester 2, 2026 courses start between 1 July and 31 December 2026.

evidence.quote: Skills NSW provides fully subsidised training to gain skills in Australia's growing industries.
Students can enrol in one Fee-free course per semester.
